title: Performance of New Diagnostic Methods in Older Adults With Pneumonia
official: Establishing and Implementing Pneumonia Diagnosis in ED Older Adults: A Mixed Methods Approach
summary: Create a clinical diagnostic pathway for older ED adults with pneumonia and its subgroups (bacterial, viral, and co-infection) and determine whether novel biomarkers improve diagnostic accuracy. The investigators will conduct a prospective observational trial of 250 ED patients ≥65 years old with suspected pneumonia. The investigators will perform analyses overall and by subgroups, seeking common models to ease adoption.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Adults aged 65 and older presenting to the ED with suspected pneumonia defined as (1) either a physician order for CXR OR CT OR a chief complaint consistent with dyspnea; AND (2) physician suspicion of pneumonia prior to ED testing (score of 2-5 on Likert scale)

Exclusion Criteria:

* inability to obtain consent from the patient or an LAR
* active cancer
* organ transplant
* immunosuppression
* trauma activation
* suicidal ideation
* incarceration
* antibiotics in the last 14 days
* a separate episode of lower respiratory illness in the last 30 days
